description: This file defines the JobSpecificationModel class within the OrangeHRM admin API module. The class acts as a data serializer/model that represents a job specification attachment with properties like id, filename, fileType, and fileSize. It uses traits and annotations to facilitate API serialization and documentation. The class constructor initializes the model with a PartialJobSpecificationAttachment entity, setting filters and attribute names for serialization purposes.
